courses.title: Pilgrimage Of The Womb: A Devotional Rose Dieta & Pilgrimage In Avalon
courses.description: A five-day residential retreat for women in Glastonbury, working with the spirit of Rose through a plant dieta alongside ceremony, ritual, movement, sound and meditation. The group walks to the Tor at sunrise and holds a private ceremony at Chalice Well, exploring the womb as a sacred inner temple through the archetypes of Maiden, Mother and Crone.

courses.title: 1-2-1 Womb Healing Journey
courses.description: A one-to-one journey of at least three months, online or with an in-person ceremony, for women who want to connect with the womb as an energetic centre at any stage of life. Sessions are co-created ceremonies using energy work, sound, light language and, where fitting, channelled guidance.
courses.price: £1750 for 6 bi-weekly sessions; £3300 for 12 weekly sessions

courses.title: 1-2-1 Healing Ceremony
courses.description: A two-hour in-person ceremonial session focused on womb or ancestral lineage healing, working with plant and spirit allies, hands, voice and sound. Sessions may include energetic clearing, ancestral tending, soul retrieval and channelled light codes, led by what arises on the day.
